description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Returns `authUrl`, the link the user opens (signed in to flayr, with this brand selected) to re-authorise an account that list_connected_accounts shows as needs_reauth or disconnected. It connects and disconnects nothing itself. Scheduled posts and the brand's default destination stay on the account. Give the user the link; do not open it for them. A shared-in account is reconnected in the brand that owns it (409).
(Wraps POST /api/v2/accounts/{id}/reconnect.)

brandId.description: The brand the account is connected to, as for GET /api/v2/accounts.

name: account_reconnect
title: Start reconnecting an account
